name: Sean Cleveland
original_name: ショーン・クリーヴランド
source:
"The more I like it, the more painful it is..."

An exchange student who Ichiya brought from overseas. His ability is on par with Sen'ya and is top level in the school. However, he can't read kanji at all, and his words are a bit suspicious.

Kaito is his favorite, and he chases after and courts him day and night. He's always in high spirits.

Hobby: Appreciating Kaito
Favorite Food: Kaito/Cajun Cuisine
Dislikes: Slugs and okra

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040207194717/http://www.will-game.com/BCM/gb01/char03.htm]official website[/url]]
